text:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: p99 latency increased > 2500ms for continuous-batching RPC path (us-west-2). Auto-pager to #eng-oncall. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood/contbatch/usw2

Tara (oncall): saw the page, jumping in. Is this affecting streaming & non-streaming?

Matt (runtime): looks like both. Streaming stalls show large gaps between chunks (~1-2s) intermittently. Non-streaming p95 also spiking but p99 blow-up on cont-batch.

Jess (prodeng): customer impact? any errors/timeouts?

Kevin (support): Support reports 3 customer incidents in last 10m: two get partial responses then stall, one timed out at 30s. Ticket links: https://tickets/CR-4231, CR-4232, CR-4233

Sam (SRE): digging into scheduler metrics — queue depth near capacity on a subset of nodes, lots of mixed-seqlen batches. Seen sudden shift in request mix (longer seqs) ~8m ago.

Tara (oncall): immediate mitigation ideas?

Matt (runtime): can try temporary hedging + reduce max batch size to limit tail amplification. Also can enable preemptive shedding for heavy seqs.

Jess (prodeng): roll blackhole to canary? or route streaming traffic to fallback model variant?

Matt (runtime): propose sequence: 1) route 20% of traffic for streaming to low-latency variant (model-lite) 2) reduce cont-batch max_batch from 64 -> 24 on affected pools 3) lower batching window (max_wait) from 12ms -> 4ms 4) enable per-request preemption for long sequences.

Tara (oncall): ok do 1) and 2) now. Who can run the change?

Sam (SRE): I can patch routing and batch configs. Running command to update routing policy for streaming route to fallback variant (canary):

```
# change route: streaming -> model-lite (20% traffic)
redwood route update --route streaming --variant model-lite --percent 20 --region us-west-2
```

Sam (SRE): reduce max_batch on contbatch pool 'cb-usw2-3':

```
# reduce batch size
redwood pool update cb-usw2-3 --max-batch 24 --max-wait-ms 4
```

Sam (SRE): applied to pool cb-usw2-3. Monitoring now.

Tara (oncall): drop in p99 yet?

slo-bot: p95 decreased from 450ms -> 320ms in 30s, p99 trending down from 2800ms -> 1200ms (partial).

Matt (runtime): good signal. But still see sporadic stalls from nodes with high KV cache churn — long seqs are evicting important KV slices and causing extra recompute. Will apply a targeted KV cache size bump on candidates.

Sam (SRE): bumping KV cache on cb-usw2-3 nodes by 30% (runtime toggle). Command: `infra toggle-kvcache cb-usw2-3 +30%`

Sam (SRE): KV cache bump in progress.

Kevin (support): informing affected customers: message drafted — "we're mitigating high-latency for streaming in us-west-2; temporary routing to lower-latency variant and config changes applied. We'll update in 30m." Approving to send now.

Alice (acct): please cc enterprise contacts for CR-4232 (Large customer X). They saw timeouts.

Tara (oncall): sent customer notices.

slo-bot: p99 now ~800ms, tail stalls reduced but not eliminated. Error count stable.

Matt (runtime): next: adapt scheduler fairness weights to reduce pack of long sequences dominating batches. Will push a soft priority rule: weight(short) += 1.5 relative to long.

Sam (SRE): applying schedule-weight tweak to pool cb-usw2-3: `schedulerctl set-weight cb-usw2-3 short=1.5 long=1.0`

Sam (SRE): applied. Observing batch composition shifting: short sequences fraction up ~18%.

Tara (oncall): monitoring for next 15m. Any rollback criteria? if p99 back >1500ms or error rate delta >0.5% revert changes.

Matt (runtime): agree. Also will capture heap/kv stats for a postmortem. Please preserve logs `contbatch/*` for 2 weeks.

Jess (prodeng): schedule an RCA in 48h. Include: workload mix change detection, batching heuristics, kv eviction policy, and rollout plan for permanent fix (adaptive batch sizing or seq-length-aware routing).

Kevin (support): all three affected customers notified, tickets updated. One customer requested a follow-up call, assigned to Alice.

Tara (oncall): handing off to night oncall @Matt in 30min. Matt please watch for regression; if p99 > 1200ms escalate to oncall lead.

Matt (runtime): ack. I'll stay on for 45m then hand to next oncall. Adding note: we should consider a temporary global hard cap on cont-batch max_batch=32 across all regions if this repeats.

slo-bot: last 5m snapshot: p95=310ms p99=670ms error-rate delta=0.12%

Sam (SRE): creating runbook entry for this mitigation sequence (routing -> batch-size -> kv-bump -> scheduler-weight). Link: https://runbooks/contbatch-tail-mitigation

Tara (oncall): great. Closing live mitigations for now. Keep channel updated on any regressions. :thumbsup:

Matt (runtime): final note — captured following logs for postmortem analysis:

```
# example sampled trace
request_id=abc123 node=cb-usw2-3 batch_size=42 seq_len=18 wait_ms=14 stall_ms=1200 kv_evictions=32
stack: runtime/scheduler:pack->runtime/exec:kv-fetch->runtime/attention:recompute
```

Matt (runtime): handing off. Thanks all.
